# contingency-respondent-dsl

> Respondent (Pavlovian) procedure extension for contingency-dsl: 26 named conditioning procedures (blocking, overshadowing, latent inhibition, renewal, reinstatement, conditioned inhibition, occasion setting, the peak procedure, and others) as validated, frozen Python AST nodes with a JSON-ready dict round trip. Zero runtime dependencies.

contingency-respondent-dsl is part of OperantKit, a set of Python/Rust packages for designing and running operant and respondent conditioning experiments (reinforcement schedules, session recording, analysis). Use it instead of hand-writing a record type for each Pavlovian design: every procedure has fixed field names, required and unexpected keywords are rejected with specific errors, and 28 conformance cases in 26 fixture files cover all primitives.

## Install

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-respondent-dsl
```

## Minimal example

```python
from contingency_respondent_dsl import from_dict, parse_primitive, to_dict

node = parse_primitive(
    "Renewal",
    keyword_args={
        "acquisition": {"type": "Pair.ForwardDelay", "cs": "tone", "us": "shock"},
        "extinction": {"type": "Extinction", "cs": "tone"},
        "test": {"type": "Extinction", "cs": "tone"},
        "acquisition_context": "ctx_a",
        "extinction_context": "ctx_b",
        "test_context": "ctx_a",
    },
)
print(to_dict(node)["type"])  # Renewal
print(from_dict(to_dict(node)) == node)  # True
```

The import name is `contingency_respondent_dsl`. Arguments are keyword-only and already evaluated (nested Core respondent expressions such as `Pair.ForwardDelay` or `Extinction` are plain dicts; durations are `{"value": 15, "unit": "s"}`). Errors: `UnknownPrimitiveError`, `ArityError`, `MissingFieldError`, `UnknownFieldError`. This package does not read DSL source text; that is the Core parser's job.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-respondent-dsl/blob/main/README.md): scope, install, 30-second example, why not to hand-roll a procedure record, usage
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-respondent-dsl/blob/main/AGENTS.md): when to use this package and what not to do
- [Grammar](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-respondent-dsl/blob/main/spec/en/grammar.md): EBNF for the 26 primitives
- [Primitive index](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-respondent-dsl/blob/main/spec/en/tier-b-primitives/_index.md): operational definition and primary citation for each procedure

## Related packages

- [contingency-dsl](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-dsl): the language specification whose respondent layer this package extends
- [contingency-dsl-py](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-dsl-py): Python parser for the Core language (`pip install contingency-dsl-py`)
- [contingency-py](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-py): reinforcement schedule engine for the operant side (`pip install contingency-py`)
- [contingency-rs](https://github.com/OperantKit/contingency-rs): Rust schedule engine and parser
